g.text: At CAD 1.5 million, minimum down changes to 20%; the line is split at that boundary.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: Sources: CMHC and Finance Canada; versioned rule record dated November 16, 2026. Values are rounded to the nearest CAD.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: Prices and closing allowances are assumptions, not provincial market prices. Upfront cash only; not approval, all taxes or a complete closing budget.
